subject: CE-1: cross-encoder rerank sidecar + client (mirror embed)
description:
Add a cross-encoder reranker sidecar and client mirroring the MiniLM embed pattern, in repo /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator.

NEW lib/rerank-server.js — clone lib/embed-server.js structure: detached Unix-socket sidecar, lazy model load, IDLE_MS + HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT lifecycle, cleanup of sock/pid. Use @xenova/transformers with a CROSS-ENCODER model `Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2` via the text-classification / sequence-classification pipeline (query+doc pair → relevance logit), NOT feature-extraction. Endpoint: POST /rerank {query:string, docs:string[]} -> {scores:number[]} (one score per doc, same order). GET /ping -> {ok,ready}. Use a SEPARATE socket/pid path from embed (e.g. rerank.sock / rerank.pid) so it coexists with the embed sidecar.

NEW lib/rerank.js — clone lib/embed.js client: lazy spawn (detached+unref), reconnect-to-running-sidecar on daemon restart, /ping heartbeat. CRITICAL null-safe degrade: export async rerank(query, docs) that returns number[]|null — null when the sidecar is unavailable/errors/times out, so callers fall back to cosine order (same philosophy as embed()->null => lexical). Export rerankStatus()/ping() like embed.js.

Do NOT wire into /search in this task (that is CE-2). Just the sidecar+client + their unit-level smoke (a tiny script or test that spawns, reranks 2-3 docs against a query, asserts higher relevance ranks higher, and that an unreachable sidecar yields null).

Follow embed-server.js / embed.js conventions exactly (BASE path, SOCKET_PATH derivation, model cache dir).
